title: WealthPilot
tagline: WealthPilot is an AI-powered financial advisor that provides smart investment insights, real-time updates, and automated portfolio management to help users grow and manage their wealth with confidence.
description: WealthPilot is an AI-driven autonomous financial advisor that provides smart, data-backed investment insights and financial planning. Built on eliza framework, it analyzes market trends, personal goals, and risk tolerance to deliver customized recommendations. With real-time updates and automated portfolio management, WealthPilot empowers users to navigate their financial journey with confidence and precision, ensuring optimal wealth growth and security.
how_its_made: We are building on top of Eliza OS framework, allowing us to leverage existing plugin for the interaction. To be more accurate on the crypto market, we have focusing the development of plugins to have access to latest crypto price in the market. According so, we have build a plugin to fetch the last BTC price using eoracle, relying on the Eigen Layer security.
